description: One country's facts, the official free routes first, then what is hard from abroad by scheme and process, what the money is worth and dated obligations. Every fact carries its source and read date. Pass question or pensionType to get one kind of pension.

country.description: A country: English or native name, alias or ISO code, for example NL or Netherlands.

language.description: Optional. Language of our own sentences, default en: en, ar, da, de, es, fa, fr, hi, id, it, ja, ko, nb, nl, pl, pt, pt-BR, ro, ru, sv, th, tl, tr, zh, vi, uk, bg. Facts stay as stored.

pensionType.description: Optional. state, workplace, provident or personal. Overrides the question.

question.description: Optional. The person's question in plain words, used only to tell which kind of pension it is about.

name: country_pension_facts
title: Country pension facts
